adj[q].add(p)\n\ndef lab(p):\n    r = by_id[p]\n    c = f'${float(r[\"direct_payment_usd\"]):.0f} {r[\"compensation_reason\"]}' if r[\"record_date\"] else \"NO CLAIM\"\n    return f'{p} {r[\"full_name\"]:18s} [{c}]'\n\nBIG = [\"PAT_033\", \"PAT_265\", \"PAT_006\"]\nfor b in BIG:\n    print(\"=\" * 95)\n    print(\"BIG:\", lab(b), \" surname:\", by_id[b][\"second_name\"])\n    dist = {b: 0}; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011Cg49ZLE4sWd7h6EvwbbjL","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01LX1XCs1qr2EeDHECzVnh5y","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /app/work/dates.py <<'EOF'\nimport csv, sys\nfrom collections import defaultdict, Counter\n\nrows = list(csv.DictReader(open(sys.argv[1])))\nby_id = {r[\"patient_id\"]: r for r in rows}\nout = {r[\"patient_id\"]: r[\"emergency_contact_patient_id\"] for r in rows}\ninc = defaultdict(list)\nfor r in rows: inc[r[\"emergency_contact_patient_id\"]].append(r[\"patient_id\"])\nnbr = lambda p: set([out[p]]) | set(inc[p])\nnoclaim = lambda p: not by_id[p][\"record_date\"]\n\nbydate = defaultdict(list)\nfor r in rows:\n    if r[\"record_date\"]: bydate[r[\"record_date\"]].append(r[\"patient_id\"])\n\nprint(\"### dates with >=3 claims (possible shared incident) ###\")\nfor d, ps in sorted(bydate.items()):\n    if len(ps) >= 3:\n        print(f\"\\n {d}: \")\n        for p in ps:\n            r = by_id[p]\n            print(f\"    {p} {r['full_name']:16s} ${float(r['direct_payment_usd']):>8.0f} {r['compensation_reason']:32s} ec->{out[p]} {by_id[out[p]]['full_name']}{' NOCLAIM' if noclaim(out[p]) else ''}\")\n        # shared EC targets within this date group?\n        ecs = Counter(out[p] for p in ps)\n        sh = {k:v for k,v in ecs.items() if v>1}\n        if sh: print(\"     SHARED EC within date:\", {f\"{k} {by_id[k]['full_name']}{'(noclaim)' if noclaim(k) else ''}\":v for k,v in sh.items()})\n\nprint(\"\\n\\n### no-claim people who are EC of >=2 claimants sharing ONE date ###\")\nfor p in by_id:\n    if not noclaim(p): continue\n    ds = [by_id[c][\"record_date\"] for c in inc[p] if by_id[c][\"record_date\"]]\n    cnt = Counter(ds)\n    for d, n in cnt.items():\n        if n >= 2:\n            print(f\"  {p} {by_id[p]['full_name']:16s} is EC of {n} claimants all on {d}: \"\n                  f\"{[(c, by_id[c]['full_name'], by_id[c]['compensation_reason']) for c in inc[p] if by_id[c]['record_date']==d]}\")\n\nprint(\"\\n\\n### big-claim dates vs neighbours' dates ###\")\nfor b in [\"PAT_033\",\"PAT_265\",\"PAT_006\"]:\n    print(f\"  {b} {by_id[b]['full_name']} big claim on {by_id[b]['record_date']}\")\n    for v in sorted(nbr(b)):\n        print(f\"      nbr {v} {by_id[v]['full_name']:16s} date={by_id[v]['record_date'] or '  (none)  '} {by_id[v]['compensation_reason']}\")\nEOF\npython -I /app/work/dates.py /app/dataset/hospital_compensation_registry.csv","description":"Analyze date clustering for shared incidents"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3346,"cache_read_input_tokens":49412,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":3346,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b9be0b79-17e5-40f6-85e0-5da2a6478fed","uuid":"11053180-28c2-40fb-a1a5-aa40c08cbd36","timestamp":"2026-10-15T14:05:02.576Z"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011Cg49ecFs532SgZctZabJw","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01YU7HPgTb1Jhf4gRyHjwMCS","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /app/work/score.py <<'EOF'\nimport csv, sys\nfrom collections import defaultdict, deque\n\nrows = list(csv.DictReader(open(sys.argv[1])))\nby_id = {r[\"patient_id\"]: r for r in rows}\norder = {r[\"patient_id\"]: i for i, r in enumerate(rows)}\nout = {r[\"patient_id\"]: r[\"emergency_contact_patient_id\"] for r in rows}\ninc = defaultdict(list)\nfor r in rows: inc[r[\"emergency_contact_patient_id\"]].append(r[\"patient_id\"])\nadj = defaultdict(set)\nfor p,q in out.items(): adj[p].add(q); adj[q].add(p)\nnoclaim = lambda p: not by_id[p][\"record_date\"]\npay = lambda p: float(by_id[p][\"direct_payment_usd\"]) if by_id[p][\"record_date\"] else 0.0\nBIG = {\"PAT_033\":\"bereavement\", \"PAT_265\":\"family support\", \"PAT_006\":\"life event\"}\n\ndists = {}\nfor b in BIG:\n    d = {b:0}; q=deque([b])\n    while q:\n        u=q.popleft()\n        for v in adj[u]:\n            if v not in d: d[v]=d[u]+1; q.append(v)\n    dists[b]=d\n\nprint(\"### Ranking ALL no-claim patients ###\")\ncands=[]\nfor p in by_id:\n    if not noclaim(p): continue\n    adjbig = [b for b in BIG if b in adj[p]]\n    surmatch = [b for b in BIG if by_id[b][\"second_name\"]==by_id[p][\"second_name\"]]\n    mind = min(dists[b].get(p, 99) for b in BIG)\n    nbrpay = sum(pay(v) for v in adj[p])\n    score = 100*len(adjbig) + 30*len(surmatch) + (20 if any(b in adj[p] and by_id[b]['second_name']==by_id[p]['second_name'] for b in BIG) else 0) - mind\n    cands.append((score, p, adjbig, surmatch, mind, nbrpay, len(inc[p])))\ncands.sort(reverse=True)\nprint(f\"{'score':>6} {'id':8} {'name':18} {'adj-to-BIG':26} {'surname-match':16} {'minD':>4} {'nbr$':>9} {'indeg':>5}\")\nfor s,p,ab,sm,md,np_,ind in cands[:14]:\n    print(f\"{s:6.0f} {p:8} {by_id[p]['full_name']:18} {str([BIG[b] for b in ab]):26} {str([BIG[b] for b in sm]):16} {md:4} {np_:9.0f} {ind:5}\")\n\nprint(\"\\n### no-claim people whose EC is ALSO no-claim (chains of non-filers) ###\")\nfor p in by_id:\n    if noclaim(p) and noclaim(out[p]):\n        print(f\"   {p} {by_id[p]['full_name']:18} -> {out[p]} {by_id[out[p]]['full_name']}\")\n\nprint(\"\\n### row order positions ###\")\nfor b in BIG: print(f\"   BIG {b} at row {order[b]}\")\nfor p in [\"PAT_174\",\"PAT_065\",\"PAT_023\",\"PAT_032\",\"PAT_126\"]:\n    print(f\"   cand {p} {by_id[p]['full_name']:18} at row {order[p]}\")\nEOF\npython -I /app/work/score.py /app/dataset/hospital_compensation_registry.csv","description":"Score all non-filers across signals"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3692,"cache_read_input_tokens":52758,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":3692,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b9be0b79-17e5-40f6-85e0-5da2a6478fed","uuid":"4acfdcd9-1b66-41af-ab61-e9277cecb58b","timestamp":"2026-10-15T14:07:22.304Z"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011Cg4Aivoov3hqcvQvYQJH3","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01GcjNacU8X7qh4UX9YAGSJ1","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /app/work/sim.py <<'EOF'\nimport csv, sys, random\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\nrows = list(csv.DictReader(open(sys.argv[1])))\nby_id = {r[\"patient_id\"]: r for r in rows}\nout = {r[\"patient_id\"]: r[\"emergency_contact_patient_id\"] for r in rows}\ninc = defaultdict(list)\nfor r in rows: inc[r[\"emergency_contact_patient_id\"]].append(r[\"patient_id\"])\nnbr = lambda p: (set([out[p]]) | set(inc[p])) - {p}\nsur = lambda p: by_id[p][\"second_name\"]\nBIG = [\"PAT_033\",\"PAT_265\",\"PAT_006\"]\nids = list(by_id)\n\n# Observed: all 3 big claimants have >=1 same-surname neighbour\nobs = sum(1 for b in BIG if any(sur(v)==sur(b) for v in nbr(b)))\nprint(\"observed big claimants with a same-surname neighbour:\", obs, \"/3\")\nprint(\"degrees of big claimants:\", {b: len(nbr(b)) for b in BIG})\n\n# Null 1: pick 3 random claimants with the same degrees, how often do all 3 have same-surname nbr?\nclaimants = [p for p in ids if by_id[p][\"record_date\"]]\nhit = 0; trials = 200000\nrnd = random.Random(0)\npool_by_deg = defaultdict(list)\nfor p in claimants: pool_by_deg[len(nbr(p))].append(p)\ndegs = [len(nbr(b)) for b in BIG]\nfor _ in range(trials):\n    ok = True\n    for d in degs:\n        c = rnd.choice(pool_by_deg[d])\n        if not any(sur(v)==sur(c) for v in nbr(c)): ok = False; break\n    if ok: hit += 1\nprint(f\"P(3 random degree-matched claimants all have same-surname nbr) = {hit/trials:.4f}\")\n\n# Null 2: shuffle surnames across patients, recompute\nhit2 = 0\nsurnames = [sur(p) for p in ids]\nfor _ in range(20000):\n    rnd.shuffle(surnames)\n    s = dict(zip(ids, surnames))\n    if all(any(s[v]==s[b] for v in nbr(b)) for b in BIG): hit2 += 1\nprint(f\"P(all 3 big claimants have same-surname nbr | surnames shuffled) = {hit2/20000:.4f}\")\n\nprint(\"\\n### Does ANY other claimant pair the 'big-payout + same-surname neighbour' combo? ###\")\nfor p in claimants:\n    if float(by_id[p][\"direct_payment_usd\"]) > 60000:\n        s=[v for v in nbr(p) if sur(v)==sur(p)]\n        print(f\"   {p} {by_id[p]['full_name']:16s} ${float(by_id[p]['direct_payment_usd']):.0f} -> same-surname nbr {[(v,by_id[v]['full_name']) for v in s]}\")\nEOF\npython -I /app/work/sim.py /app/dataset/hospital_compensation_registry.csv","description":"Simulate null hypothesis for surname enrichment"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":792,"cache_read_input_tokens":64453,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":792,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b9be0b79-17e5-40f6-85e0-5da2a6478fed","uuid":"9aae436d-a08b-4bfe-b890-61f87c2be528","timestamp":"2026-10-15T14:21:41.143Z"}
